text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking around the academy 
grounds――

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaahhh! Out of the way, please get out 
of the waaay!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Whew…… I nearly crashed right into you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ah, I'm sorry for startling you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This morning's horoscope said putting your 
all into everything will boost your luck!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's why I do a Good-Fortune Dash 
whenever I move around! And a Good-Fortune 
Early-Lunch if I get hungry in class!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If I get caught, it's time for a 
high-speed fortune-bringing dogeza!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This exhilaration...! I cannot help but 
feel my fortune soaring to the heavens!!
choice_data_list:
I get the feeling she's just in a rush, 
though……
How about putting some spirit into it too?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
――Gasp! I-It's not like I was just letting 
my excitement get the better of me or 
anything!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Still... Mmh-mmh-mmh... Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Just as you say, take each and every thing 
seriously! I'll keep that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
On the upcoming quiz, I'll write so 
carefully and firmly that the pen tip will 
practically tremble...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'll mobilize all my divination knowledge 
and fill it out in runic script!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your all-out effort, but 
you'll be getting remedial classes for 
this.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, goodness! I suppose my fighting spirit 
was still lacking...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All right! Then I'll give it my all during 
warm-ups with the Raging Shaman Pose!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let's put this into practice immediately 
as we make our way over to the training 
grounds—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Eco-eco-seal, one-two-three-foooour!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Eek! What's with that movement—?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This was the very moment the "Eco-Eco Seal 
Calisthenics" were born—a routine that 
would later become a quiet craze among 
Umamusume.
